metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.6 · 2011 · Rise of the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: A substance designed to help the brain repair itself gives advanced intelligence to a chimpanzee who leads an ape uprising.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.6 · 2014 · Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: The fragile peace between apes and humans is threatened as mistrust and betrayal threaten to plunge both tribes into a war for dominance over the Earth.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.4 · 2017 · War for the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.8 · 2024 · Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 8.0 · 1968 · Planet of the Apes
metas.description: After being kept in hypersleep during a long expedition into deep space, an astronaut crew crash-lands in the 40th century on a planet where highly intelligent non-human ape species are dominant and humans are enslaved.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.0 · 1970 · Beneath the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: The sole survivor of an interplanetary rescue mission searches for the only survivor of the previous expedition. He discovers a planet ruled by apes and an underground city run by telepathic humans.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.3 · 1971 · Escape from the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: The world is shocked by the appearance of three talking chimpanzees, who arrived mysteriously in a U.S. spacecraft. They become the toast of society, but one man believes them to be a threat to the human race.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.1 · 1972 · Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: In a futuristic world that has embraced ape slavery, Caesar, the son of the late simians Cornelius and Zira, surfaces after almost twenty years of hiding out from the authorities, and prepares for a slave revolt against humanity.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 5.4 · 1973 · Battle for the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: Ten years after a worldwide series of ape revolutions and a brutal nuclear war among humans, Caesar must protect survivors of both species from an insidious human cult and a militant ape faction alike.
